node.title: Re: DBD::SYBASE varchar(max) problem
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: It seems like you're running into bug [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=116065|#116065: DBD-Sybase does not support [n]varchar(max)]. Unfortunately it doesn't seem like there is a patch (yet), so if choosing a large upper limit is an option for you, you might have to use that workaround for now.
